title: Nutella Mini Milks
description: Indulgent chocolate ice lollies made from coconut cream, Nutella and dark chocolate — a homemade tribute to the classic Mini Milk lolly.
steps: Clean and dry lolly moulds. Lightly grease the inside with sunflower oil.
Blitz the chilled coconut cream with the Nutella in a blender on high for a few minutes.
Melt the chocolate in the microwave in 20-second bursts. Allow to cool, then add to the blender and blend everything together.
Pour into the moulds to about three-quarters full. Freeze overnight.
Run under a hot tap for 20 seconds to release.
notes: Makes 12 mini milks or 6 normal-sized lollies. For an adult twist, swap the dark chocolate for a slug of Baileys.
